edits.why: The mount journal greys out every mount and refuses drags below this level, whatever the character can ride. The server lets everyone ride from level 1 (T-011).

edits.name: Call of Xuen
edits.description: Xuen's Gift. Call the spirit of Xuen, the White Tiger, to fight at your side, its claws crackling with lightning. Your critical strikes build Thunder, which keeps the tiger with you longer and brings the Gift back sooner.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger (monk talent).

edits.name: Crane's Plume
edits.description: Chi-Ji's Gift. The Red Crane's hope heals you and the most wounded members of your group. Healing you do or receive builds Hope, which makes the next Plume stronger.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Spirit of Chi-Ji (legendary cloak proc); cannot crit, as the core makes the source.

edits.name: Niuzao's Retort
edits.description: Niuzao's Gift. After a heavy blow, answer with the Black Ox's charge, striking the enemies before you for a share of the damage you just took. Usable only for a few seconds after the blow.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Ox Charge (creature spell).

edits.name: Serpent's Breath
edits.description: Yu'lon's Gift. Breathe jade fire in a cone, burning every enemy before you. Your spell casts build Coil, which makes the next Breath stronger.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Celestial Breath (creature spell); ticks start after the first period, as the core makes the source.

edits.name: Ferocity of Xuen
edits.description: Haste while the White Tiger fights at your side.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift rider aura (T-086): its own name and tooltip instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Berserking (troll racial).

edits.why: Heartseed Gift rider aura (T-086): its own name and tooltip instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Sprint (rogue).

edits.description: The Black Ox's strength shields you from harm.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift rider aura (T-086): its own name and tooltip instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Ice Barrier (mage).

edits.why: Heartseed Gift rider aura (T-086): its own name and tooltip instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of a creature curse that lowers damage dealt.
